Built-in datasets

Source: R/express-data.R
px_data.Rd

Datasets used in the plotly.express examples, returned as data.tables.

Usage

px_data_gapminder(
  datetimes = FALSE,
  centroids = FALSE,
  year = NULL,
  pretty_names = FALSE
)

px_data_tips(pretty_names = FALSE)

px_data_iris()

px_data_wind()

px_data_election()

px_data_election_geojson()

px_data_carshare()

px_data_stocks(datetimes = FALSE)

px_data_experiment()

px_data_medals_wide()

px_data_medals_long()

Arguments

datetimes

Convert the date column to Date.

centroids

Keep country centroid columns.

year

Keep only this year.

pretty_names

Use readable column names.

Value

A data.table (a GeoJSON list for px_data_election_geojson()).

Details

  • px_data_gapminder(): life expectancy, population and GDP per capita by country and year (1704 rows). datetimes = TRUE makes year a Date; centroids = TRUE keeps the centroid_lat and centroid_lon columns; year filters to one year; pretty_names = TRUE uses readable column names.

  • px_data_tips(): restaurant bills and tips (244 rows).

  • px_data_iris(): Fisher's iris measurements, with a numeric species_id (150 rows).

  • px_data_wind(): wind direction and strength frequencies (128 rows).

  • px_data_election(): results of the 2013 Montreal mayoral election by district (58 rows); px_data_election_geojson() returns the district boundaries as a GeoJSON list.

  • px_data_carshare(): car-sharing availability in Montreal (249 rows).

  • px_data_stocks(): weekly closing prices of six technology stocks, normalised to 1 on 2018-01-01 (105 rows). datetimes = TRUE makes date a Date.

  • px_data_experiment(): results of a fictional experiment (100 rows).

  • px_data_medals_wide(), px_data_medals_long(): medal counts by nation in wide and long form.

Examples

head(px_data_gapminder(year = 2007))

#> 2:     Albania    Europe  2007  76.423  3600523  5937.0295       ALB       8
#> 3:     Algeria    Africa  2007  72.301 33333216  6223.3675       DZA      12
#> 4:      Angola    Africa  2007  42.731 12420476  4797.2313       AGO      24
#> 5:   Argentina  Americas  2007  75.320 40301927 12779.3796       ARG      32
#> 6:   Australia   Oceania  2007  81.235 20434176 34435.3674       AUS      36
